brand.name: NEW AGE ALGORITHMS
style: Top centre: the brand mark - four ascending gold bars (like a rising bar chart) above the wordmark 'NEW AGE ALGORITHMS' in elegant spaced serif capitals, 'NEW AGE' in black and 'ALGORITHMS' in gold.
Directly under the wordmark, a thin gold rule and the small letterspaced tagline 'TRADING | INVESTING | A BETTER YOU' in muted gold.
Background: a rich, photorealistic, cinematic Indian scene matching the quote's theme, warm golden light, shallow depth of field, premium editorial photography.
Centre: a large ivory / cream rounded-rectangle panel with a very thin gold border and a soft shadow, occupying about 60% of the width.

Inside the panel: a large gold opening double-quote mark at the top, then the quote in a high-contrast elegant serif typeface (like Playfair Display), in near-black, with two or three key words highlighted in gold.
Below the quote: a short thin gold horizontal rule, then the attribution in small letterspaced sans-serif capitals in warm grey.
Typography must be perfectly spelled and legible, generous line spacing, nothing crowded, no watermark, no extra text, no logo of any other brand.
